reason: Selected bank interventions show skill utility depends on composition and deployment distribution.

candidates.title: Audit new skills in the bank combinations where they will run
candidates.rule: When admitting skills to a self-evolving memory agent, compare sampled coalition contributions with a whole-bank outcome gate rather than judging each skill as independently useful.
candidates.finding: Under the authors’ K-controlled audit, additions admitted by the baseline are collectively negative by 1.38 points averaged across three evaluation domains, despite passing their admission criterion. Coalition-aware selection changes the gate under the matched MemSkill protocol.
workloads: HotpotQA; ALFWorld also in evaluation scope
candidates.conditions: Three seeds, fixed judge; CASS adds eight coalition evaluations per outer epoch.
candidates.limitations: Small banks and one base framework. Sampled Shapley marginals estimate contributions and depend on coalition sampling. A lower acceptance rate is not inherently better or proof of mechanism.
candidates.validation_test: Compare outcome-only and coalition-aware gates at measured total budget; test proposed skills in varied existing banks on disjoint tasks and report regressions as well as gains.

candidates.title: Re-audit a skill bank after domain transfer
candidates.rule: When moving a learned memory-skill bank to a new domain, compare the full bank with selectively masked variants rather than assuming source-useful skills remain helpful.
candidates.finding: Label-free target retrieval-quality masking improves all six tested banks on HP-50 judged outcomes, with larger average gains for baseline MemSkill banks than CASS banks. The audit identifies an insert-memory skill whose utility reverses across domains.
workloads: Transfer of conversational-memory skills to HP-50 HotpotQA
candidates.conditions: Uses twenty unlabeled target queries and raw contexts, rebuilding memory for skill knockouts before deployment.
candidates.limitations: Only six banks and a narrow target. Retrieval similarity is a surrogate, not guaranteed downstream correctness. O(K squared) memory rebuilds impose adaptation cost even without per-query inference overhead.
candidates.validation_test: Evaluate full and masked banks on new labeled target queries after choosing the mask on separate unlabeled probes; measure QA, evidence recall, rare-skill regressions and adaptation cost.
